summary: This document describes how to optimize ARP and Neighbor Discovery traffic in a TRILL campus. TRILL switches keep a cache of IP, MAC and Data Label bindings learned from ARP and ND messages and can answer from it, which reduces broadcast traffic.

eli5.summary: Instead of shouting to the whole room, who has this address, a helper who already knows the answer replies directly.
